theorems.name: Submission.inner_fderiv_normal_field_eq_neg_second_fundamental_form
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b)) → ∀ (Y : Rn N → Rn N) (y : Rn N), y ∈ M → DifferentiableAt ℝ Y y → (∀ z ∈ M, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M z, inner ℝ (Y z) v = 0) → ∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ η (fderiv ℝ Y y τ) = -inner ℝ (Y y) (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η)
